title: Clone empty repo → seed plant
trigger: Developer clones a brand-new empty repository
edgeCase: Growth 0 seed silhouette is tiny (12px); viz must not hide or inflate it
expectedBehaviour: Dock home bay; seed plant appears; mark idle/curious peeking at new ground

title: First commit → sprout
trigger: First commit lands on an empty repo
edgeCase: 0→1 transition must animate silhouette height without jump-cut to canopy
expectedBehaviour: Desk focus; growth 0→1 sprout; happy/allowed face

title: Init with README only
trigger: gh repo create with README, no code yet
edgeCase: Sprout with almost no history — growth 1 vs activity emptiness
expectedBehaviour: Dock wave greeting; plant stays sprout until real commits

title: PR opened
trigger: Pull request opened against main
edgeCase: Leaf plant linked by cable to root — two silhouettes plus link chrome in strip
expectedBehaviour: Asking face at desk; cable hints PR from feature/x into app

title: Review requested
trigger: Reviewer assigned / review requested on PR
edgeCase: Evaluating face + read action while leaf plant waits — dual focus
expectedBehaviour: Desk evaluating/read; leaf stays sapling until merge

title: PR approved
trigger: All required reviews approved
edgeCase: Gate stage usually means deny — here gate = clearance; must not default to denied face
expectedBehaviour: Gate with allowed/nod; cable still present until merge

title: Changes requested
trigger: Reviewer requests changes on PR
edgeCase: Leaf plant not growth-downgraded; weed framing must stay design-note only
expectedBehaviour: Gate warning/point; leaf unchanged; optional weedsNote about revision shoot
weedsNote: Revision shoot — not a kit weed prop; design vocabulary for 'needs more work'

title: PR merged
trigger: Pull request merged into main
edgeCase: Leaf collapses or vanishes while root grows — connection teardown timing
expectedBehaviour: Rooftop celebrate; root young→branching; leaf seed/gone after merge

title: Draft PR opened
trigger: Draft pull request created (not ready)
edgeCase: Draft vs ready PR — same cable kind, different face; viz needs draft chrome without new kit id
expectedBehaviour: Workshop peek/sandboxing; cable dim or dashed in host chrome only

title: CI green on main
trigger: CI workflow succeeds on main
edgeCase: relieved emotion is unbridged (no legacyFaceBridge face) — habitat-only emotion
expectedBehaviour: Desk relieved/nod; plant stays branching

title: CI failed
trigger: CI workflow fails on a PR branch
edgeCase: rain weather + gate + error face — triple chrome stack without clutter
expectedBehaviour: Gate error/shakeHead; rain weather; leaf unchanged

title: Flaky CI (pass then fail)
trigger: Same check fails intermittently; re-run flips green/red
edgeCase: startled emotion without lasting growth change — emotion-only flicker
expectedBehaviour: Gate warning/startled lookBack; no growth update; host may pulse weather

title: CI cancelled mid-run
trigger: Developer cancels a running workflow
edgeCase: cancelled face bridges to dock — should not look like CI error
expectedBehaviour: Dock cancelled/embarrassed; plant unchanged

title: Merge conflict
trigger: Merge blocked by conflicting files
edgeCase: Two leaf cables into one root — crossed cables read as conflict without new propKind
expectedBehaviour: Gate denied; dual cables into canopy; rain chrome
weedsNote: Nutrient thieves — two shoots fighting same trunk nutrients (design only)

title: Rebase conflict pain
trigger: Interactive rebase hits conflicts repeatedly
edgeCase: Workshop usually means build — here repair; sparks+error vs executing
expectedBehaviour: Workshop crouch/frustrated; leaf still linked; not celebrating

title: Push to main
trigger: Direct push (or merge) updates main tip
edgeCase: carry action for 'shipping bits' — rare action; ensure adapters render
expectedBehaviour: Workshop carrying update; canopy holds

title: Release tagged
trigger: v1.x.x git tag / GitHub Release published
edgeCase: Growth already 5 canopy — celebrate without inventing growth 6
expectedBehaviour: Rooftop celebrate; canopy maxed; no overshoot

title: Pre-release tag
trigger: v1.0.0-rc.1 published as pre-release
edgeCase: Almost-release vs release — same plant, softer face than rooftop
expectedBehaviour: Desk asking; branching plant; not yet rooftop proud

title: Routine dependency bump
trigger: Dependabot / Renovate opens minor bump PR
edgeCase: dependency role plant + dependency link kind — distinct from cable PR links
expectedBehaviour: Archives scan; dependency plant linked into root

title: Supply-chain scare
trigger: Compromised or yanked package alert on a dependency
edgeCase: Dependency plant should look hostile without new weed propKind
expectedBehaviour: Gate denied/startled; dependency link highlighted as threat
weedsNote: Blight on dependency shoot — design vocabulary only; still propKind repoBranch

title: Major breaking dep bump
trigger: Major semver bump with breaking changes
edgeCase: Growth unchanged but tone warn — chrome-only signal
expectedBehaviour: Desk warning/think; dependency still young; no auto growth drop

title: Monorepo one canopy many packages
trigger: Viewing a monorepo with packages/* under one git root
edgeCase: Five plants + four workspace links in one strip — overcrowding / label collision
expectedBehaviour: Dock overview; one canopy root; package leaves linked by workspace kind

title: Monorepo single package CI fail
trigger: CI fails only in packages/console while kit is green
edgeCase: Point which leaf failed without dimming healthy siblings
expectedBehaviour: Gate error pointing at console leaf; kit leaf stays healthy

title: Monorepo internal workspace bump
trigger: packages/bot bumps workspace dep on packages/kit
edgeCase: Leaf-to-leaf dependency plus workspace-to-root — link graph density
expectedBehaviour: Archives scan; bot→kit dependency overlay on workspace tree

title: Polyrepo several plants linked
trigger: Three separate repos that share a product surface
edgeCase: Multiple roots (no single canopy) — garden metaphor stretches
expectedBehaviour: Desk alert scan; three root plants; cables into api as hub

title: Polyrepo npm workspace-style link
trigger: Local workspace:* links across sibling checkouts
edgeCase: workspace kind between two roots (not mono leaves) — same kind, different topology
expectedBehaviour: Dock loading walk; workspace cable between peer roots

title: Two orgs: API consumer/provider
trigger: Org A provider API repo; Org B consumer app talks over remote
edgeCase: remote link kind across org namespaces — labels with slash; viz spacing
expectedBehaviour: Archives search; remote cable between org plants; both roots

title: Cross-org breaking API change
trigger: Provider ships breaking OpenAPI; consumer CI fails
edgeCase: Which plant 'owns' the warn face — provider or consumer habitat
expectedBehaviour: Gate warning; remote link stressed; growth unchanged
weedsNote: Invasive dual-table fork risk if both orgs invent parallel API schemas (design only)

title: Abandoned branch beside canopy
trigger: Stale feature branch untouched for months next to active main
edgeCase: stale role + growth 1 next to canopy 5 — contrast without weed propKind
expectedBehaviour: Archives sad lookBack; stale sprout beside canopy; cable faded
weedsNote: Stale shoot — abandoned branch weed vocabulary; still repoBranch + growth

title: Diverged fork as invasive
trigger: Long-lived fork diverged from upstream with dual tables
edgeCase: fork role vs leaf — both may use remote/cable; role must drive chrome
expectedBehaviour: Archives warning/read; fork canopy near upstream; remote link
weedsNote: Invasive dual-table fork — design weed; do not invent kit weed constants

title: Secrets leaked
trigger: Secret scanning alert / .env committed
edgeCase: Highest urgency face without growth change — chrome must scream
expectedBehaviour: Gate denied/startled; rain; plant growth unchanged

title: Offline / no network
trigger: Host loses network; cannot fetch remotes or CI
edgeCase: nightwatch sleep vs sad archives for abandoned — same offline face family
expectedBehaviour: Nightwatch sleep; plant still young in dark habitat

title: Cancelled work / abandoned PR
trigger: PR closed without merge; work discarded
edgeCase: Leaf demoted to stale + growth drop — teardown vs merge celebration
expectedBehaviour: Dock cancelled; leaf becomes stale sprout; cable may dissolve
weedsNote: Stale shoot after cancel — design only

title: Agent sandboxing loop
trigger: Mininja agent enters sandboxed tool trial
edgeCase: Agent loop faces must map 1:1 to legacyFaceBridge without mood ids
expectedBehaviour: Workshop sandboxing/peek; mono canopy present as backdrop

title: Agent executing tools
trigger: Agent runs shell/MCP tools in a loop
edgeCase: Long-running execute — holdMs/intensity later; face must stay readable
expectedBehaviour: Workshop executing/type; sparks weather

title: Agent evaluating next step
trigger: Agent plans / evaluates before next tool call
edgeCase: evaluating vs thinking action — bridge uses think at desk
expectedBehaviour: Desk evaluating/think; canopy backdrop

title: Agent tool denied at gate
trigger: Policy denies a dangerous tool call
edgeCase: Gate deny is v1 core path — must not look like CI fail rain
expectedBehaviour: Gate denied/shakeHead; haze not rain; plant untouched

title: Agent task completed
trigger: Agent finishes delegated task successfully
edgeCase: Rooftop complete with mono leaves still visible in strip
expectedBehaviour: Rooftop celebrate; canopy + qa leaf remain

title: Nightwatch sleep
trigger: Idle timeout / watching paused overnight
edgeCase: Canonical sleep mapping — baseline for nightwatch family
expectedBehaviour: Nightwatch sleep under moon; plant dim

title: Desk focus / brief
trigger: Status, plan, or brief session at desk
edgeCase: Desk is default work locus — must stay distinct from workshop execute
expectedBehaviour: Desk focused/read; clear weather

title: Workshop build / ralph
trigger: Build, refine, or ralph execute loop
edgeCase: Sparks weather tied to workshop — hosts must not override to clear casually
expectedBehaviour: Workshop type/executing under sparks

title: Gate deny unknown
trigger: Ask/deny/unknown policy decision
edgeCase: asking at gate vs denied — same stage, opposite outcomes
expectedBehaviour: Gate wait/asking; barrier props matter

title: Rooftop complete / proud
trigger: Milestone shipped; proud moment
edgeCase: jump vs celebrate — both ok; recipe packs should pick one
expectedBehaviour: Rooftop jump/proud; canopy

title: No plants yet (pre-garden)
trigger: Habitat open before any repo overlay authored
edgeCase: Empty plants[] — creature+habitat must still render; garden optional
expectedBehaviour: Dock blink idle; no repoBranch props; mark-only garden chrome absent

title: Mono canopy talking to external org
trigger: Monorepo packages depend on external org SDK remotely
edgeCase: workspace + remote mixed graph; mirrored loadingLeft face
expectedBehaviour: Desk loadingLeft walk; mono leaf remote-cabled to vendor

title: Force-push scare on shared branch
trigger: Force-push to a shared feature branch
edgeCase: History rewrite — growth unchanged but warn face; no weed kit id
expectedBehaviour: Gate warning/startled; leaf intact
weedsNote: History blight risk — design vocabulary only

title: Release tag deleted
trigger: Someone deletes a published tag
edgeCase: Canopy stays 5 after tag delete — growth ≠ release chrome
expectedBehaviour: Dock cancelled lookBack; canopy unchanged

title: Monorepo matrix CI all green
trigger: Matrix CI passes across all packages
edgeCase: Celebrate with many leaves — rooftop crowding with workspace links
expectedBehaviour: Rooftop celebrate; all leaves healthy under canopy

title: Archives memory / pgeon look
trigger: Looking up past runs, memory, or logs
edgeCase: archives+scan weather default — ensure search action readable among shelves
expectedBehaviour: Archives search/curious under scan weather

title: Recipe-compatible growth object then
trigger: Simulates later-plate then.growth {prop,value} shape
edgeCase: growthUpdates mirrors recipe then.growth {prop,value} without writing scene.json
expectedBehaviour: Desk allowed; growthUpdates app 2→3; recipe-compatible then shape
